title: 第二十章 初赛收官晋级八强第十九章 瞬杀强敌
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 八强名单在告示栏上一字排开，围观弟子们的表情复杂到极点。
榜首林浩，三星灵尊入灵境，种子选手，毫无悬念。
第二名墨尘，二星灵王圆满，暗影术法的天才。
第三名周玄，二星灵王圆满，防御极其扎实。
第四名韩二水，二星灵王圆满，此人在内门排位不算顶尖，但能一路杀进八强，也证明了实力。
然后，八强名单中排在最后一位的名字，让所有人的嘴角都狠狠抽搐了一下——
杨卤。
“真的进八强了……”有人喃喃自语，声音中满是不敢置信。
“他从倒数第一，一路杀到八强，五战全胜，全部秒杀……这特么简直是玄幻小说！”
“玄幻小说都没这么写的！这剧本也太离谱了！”
“你说他修为低吧，他赢了；你说他靠运气吧，他连赢五场；你说他靠戒指吧，他早摘了……”
“我感觉我的三观正在崩塌。”
议论声中，有人叹气道：“最恐怖的是，咱们之前都笑话他倒数第一，还跟他立了赌约。现在他真进了八强，我总感觉……心里有点慌。”
这话一出，周围几个弟子脸色齐齐一白。
赌约。
那天杨卤立的赌约是——如果他拿了第一名，所有人都得管他叫爷爷！
当时大家只当是个笑话，可现在杨卤已经杀进八强了，这个笑话好像正在一点点变成现实。
“别慌！还有林浩师兄呢！”有弟子强行打气道，“林浩师兄可是三星灵尊入灵境！跟杨卤整整差了一个大境界！一个二星灵王入灵境，再怎么逆天，也不可能越一个大境界打赢三星灵尊吧？”
“对对对！林浩师兄出手，杨卤必败！”
“八强里面还有墨尘、周玄、韩二水呢，都不是善茬！杨卤想拿第一？做梦！”
“就是就是，他能打进八强已经是极限了，接下来肯定会被淘汰！”
众人你一言我一语地互相打气着，但不知怎的，这些话听起来连他们自己都不太信了。
另一边，高台之上，海富长老清了清嗓子，朗声道：“八强名单已出，恭喜以上八位弟子成功晋级！按照赛程安排，今日休整一天，明日正式开启八强淘汰赛！届时八强选手捉对厮杀，胜者晋级四强，败者淘汰！”
他顿了顿，补充道：“休整期间，请各位参赛弟子好好调息备战。尤其八强选手，注意保存实力、避免受伤，明日之战将比初赛更加激烈！”
弟子们纷纷点头，广场上的人群开始逐渐散去。
有人三五成群地讨论着八强名单，有人围在告示栏前反复研究对阵可能性，有人已经开始七嘴八舌地分析谁能夺冠。
而在广场边缘的一棵老槐树下，一道白色身影静静伫立。
瑶青池。
她穿着一身素白长裙，长发如瀑，清冷的容颜在树影下显得格外出尘。她没有靠近告示栏，也没有参与任何讨论，只是远远地看着那个方向——准确地说，是看着那个站在告示栏前、正被一群人围观讨论的身影。
杨卤。
她已经这个距离，看了好半天了。
而她脑海里反复回放的，是这三个月来的画面——
从第一天，那个年轻人拎着食盒站在她门口，被她冷脸拒绝；到后来每天雷打不动地出现，风雨无阻；再到那天她忍不住动手，反被他一巴掌扇懵；再到今天，她亲眼看着他连胜五场，一路杀进八强……
她甚至想起今天早上，他又一次出现在冰澜阁门口，依然是那副欠揍的笑容，依然是手里拎着食盒。
“圣女早！今天的玉米糕，热乎的！”
她当时依然没开门，甚至没搭理他。
但他像往常一样，把食盒放在门口，转身就走了。
content_en:
The list of top eight was lined up on the notice board, and the expressions of the disciples watching were extremely complicated.
Lin Hao is ranked first, the three-star spiritual master has entered the spiritual realm, and is the seed player. There is no suspense.
The second one is Mo Chen, the two-star spiritual king Yuan Wan, a genius of shadow magic.
The third place is Zhou Xuan, the two-star spiritual king is perfect and his defense is extremely solid.
The fourth place is Han Ershui, the two-star spiritual king is perfect. This person is not at the top of the inner sect, but he can reach the top eight all the way, which also proves his strength.
Then, the last name in the top eight list made everyone’s lips twitch violently——
Yang Lu.
"We've really made it to the top eight..." someone murmured to himself, his voice full of disbelief.
"He went from last to last all the way to the top eight, winning five battles and killing them all instantly... This is like a fantasy novel!"
"Fantasy novels are not written like this! This script is too outrageous!"
"You say his cultivation level is low, he won; you say he relied on luck, he won five games in a row; you say he relied on his ring, he picked it up long ago..."
"I feel like my perspective is collapsing."
In the discussion, someone sighed and said: "The most terrifying thing is that we all laughed at him before for finishing last and even made a bet with him. Now that he has really entered the top eight, I always feel... a little panicked."
As soon as these words came out, the faces of several disciples around him turned pale.
bet.
Yang Luli's bet that day was - if he won first place, everyone would call him grandpa!
At that time, everyone just thought it was a joke, but now that Yang Lu has reached the top eight, this joke seems to be turning into reality little by little.
"Don't panic! There is Senior Brother Lin Hao here!" A disciple cheered up, "Senior Brother Lin Hao is a three-star spiritual master who has entered the spiritual realm! He is a whole different realm away from Yang Lu! A two-star spiritual king who has entered the spiritual realm, no matter how defiant he is, cannot cross a greater realm and defeat the three-star spiritual master, right?"
"Yes, yes! If Senior Brother Lin Hao takes action, Yang Lu will be defeated!"
"There are Mo Chen, Zhou Xuan, and Han Ershui among the top eight, and they are all bad! Yang Lu wants to take first place? What a dream!"
"That's right, his ability to reach the quarterfinals is already the limit, and he will definitely be eliminated next!"
Everyone was cheering each other on, but somehow it sounded like they didn't even believe it themselves.
On the other side, on the high platform, Elder Haifu cleared his throat and said loudly: "The list of the top eight has been announced. Congratulations to the above eight disciples for their successful promotion! According to the schedule, today will be a day off, and tomorrow will officially start the knockout round of the top eight! At that time, the top eight players will fight each other, the winner will advance to the top four, and the loser will be eliminated!"
He paused and added: "During the break, all participating disciples, please adjust your breath and prepare for the competition. Especially the top eight players, pay attention to preserving your strength and avoiding injuries. Tomorrow's battle will be more intense than the preliminary round!"
The disciples nodded one after another, and the crowd in the square began to disperse.
Some people are discussing the list of the top eight in groups, some are gathering in front of the bulletin board to repeatedly study the possibility of matchups, and some have already begun to analyze who can win the championship.
And under an old locust tree on the edge of the square, a white figure stood quietly.
Yao Qingchi.
She was wearing a plain white dress, with long hair like a waterfall, and her cold face looked particularly pure under the shadow of the trees. She did not approach the notice board, nor did she participate in any discussion. She just looked in that direction from a distance - to be precise, she looked at the figure standing in front of the notice board, being watched and discussed by a group of people.
Yang Lu.
She has been looking at this distance for a long time.
And what she repeatedly replayed in her mind were the scenes from the past three months——
From the first day, when the young man stood at her door with a food box and was rejected by her with a cold face; to then showing up every day without hesitation, rain or shine; to that day when she couldn't help but make a move, but was slapped by him; to today, she watched him win five games in a row, all the way to the quarterfinals...
She even remembered that this morning, he appeared at the door of Binglan Pavilion again, still wearing that ungrateful smile and still holding the food box in his hand.
"Morning! Today's corn cake is hot!"
She still didn't open the door and didn't even answer him.
But as usual, he put the food box at the door, turned around and left.
